BD Cash Counter & Calculator is an all-in-one smart tool for cash counting, zakat calculation, age calculation and Cow Weight Calculator. Designed for Bangladesh users, this app helps you manage taka হিসাব, daily expense tracking, and personal finance easily and accurately — even without internet.

💰 Cash Counter & Expense Tracker
Cash Counter is a smart and easy money counter app designed to calculate total cash instantly by entering note quantities. This cash counter app helps you manage daily taka হিসাব, track income and expenses, and reduce manual mistakes. Perfect for shop owners and small businesses, it works as a reliable cash calculation tool with history save and PDF export feature. Fast, accurate, and fully offline for daily cash management.

💰📊🧾 Easily calculate total money by entering the number of notes. This powerful cash counter app automatically shows total taka without manual calculation.

✔️ Instant money calculation (taka counter)
✔️ Save হিসাব with history tracking
✔️ View previous records anytime
✔️ Export হিসাব as PDF (memory-style view)
✔️ Share reports via WhatsApp, Messenger
✔️ Works fully offline

Perfect for shop owners, Banker, business cash management, and daily expense tracking.

🕌 Zakat Calculator (Gold & Silver Price)
Zakat is an essential part of Islamic finance and a duty for eligible Muslims. This zakat calculator Bangladesh helps you calculate accurate zakat based on gold and silver nisab. Easily manage your zakat হিসাব with updated market prices and get instant results in BDT. A simple and reliable solution for zakat calculation, ensuring proper charity and financial responsibility.

🕌📿💰 Calculate zakat accurately using updated market rates. This zakat calculator Bangladesh supports gold and silver based Nisab calculation.

✔️ Auto zakat calculation
✔️ Live gold & silver price update (fetch option)
✔️ Accurate zakat result in BDT
✔️ Simple Islamic-friendly interface

Best for zakat হিসাব, Islamic finance calculation, and Muslim users.

🎂 Age Calculator (DOB Calculator)
Age Calculator is a simple and accurate tool to calculate age by date of birth (DOB). This age calculator shows exact age in years, months, and days instantly. You can also check age on any custom date. Perfect as a boyosh calculator, DOB calculator, and age finder. Fast, easy, and works offline—ideal for daily use in Bangladesh.

🎂📅⏳Find your exact age in seconds with this simple age calculator.
